explanation: On an infinite interval, piecewise continuity is checked on every closed bounded subinterval. The ceiling function f has only finitely many jumps on each such subinterval, with finite one-sided limits. The function g has only two jumps, at -4 and -1, also with finite limits. The function h(x)=tan(x) has infinite one-sided limits at π/2, so it fails. Thus f and g only qualify.
